segments.text: "I'm just a courier. I came to Taozhe because my job took me here."
Mastermind who Transports Fate
Heir to the Liu family.
Under orders from her father to keep her out of harm's way, Kroa was raised by her uncle.
She wields a white gun known as "Dilu", which marks her as the true heir to the Liu family.
Kroa works as an underground courier, willing to deliver anything, so long as the price is too good to refuse.
When it comes to surviving in Kumyo, she hasn't the luxury of choosing between life or death, but merely survival.
From Voltage Inc.
"If you do decide to become our boss, I swear to protect you with my life."
Avenger in Faith
A mafioso true and true who was adopted and raised by the original Liu family.
He works as a priest in a church in Taozhe, with hopes to one day rebuild the Liu family.
From Voltage Inc.
"I'm real strong when I'm drunk. If you wanna die, then come at me!"
Outlaw Drunk on Emptiness
A gangster from Taozhe.
Hiyok is determined to protect the same Taozhe he was born and raised in, but in reality, his gang was only capable of recklessly—but unsuccessfully—lashing back against the Zhuo family.
When he downs particularly strong alcohol, he becomes a whole different person, capable of taking down multiple men at once.
From Voltage Inc.
"I plan to lead the world to justice. That's the duty of those who were granted this power."
Scheming Bellwether
The boss of a huge mafia, Mun is considered the only one capable of competing with Biying.
The public knows him as the young president of a big company, thanks to his many media appearances.
Mun's natural charisma tends to win him a lot of admirers.
From Voltage Inc.
"If I wanted freedom, I'd no choice but to become a mafia boss."
Singularity who Questions Reason
Maslo is the boss of a small-time mafia from the countryside.
He's a friendly guy, and the last sort of person you'd expect to be leading a criminal organization.
Aside from being part of the mob, he's active as a popular DJ and song-writer.
From Voltage Inc.
"I always pay it back double, whether it's a favor, or I've been wronged. That's how we do it back in Fei Ying."
Sword-Wielding Peacock
A man with roots in the neighboring country of Fei Ying.
He dresses flamboyantly and carries a sword, which makes him stand out in a crowd. He's loyal to his motto of paying things back, whether it be favors or revenge.
From Voltage Inc.
"We've just been looking the other way, waiting for someone else to step up and change this city."
Twin who Weaves the Future
Hiyok's friend and a resident of Taozhe. The older twin to Zhiho, who cares deeply about her brother. Styling hair is her specialty, and she regularly cuts Zhiho's hair.
From Voltage Inc.
"We want to return Taozhe to how it used to be."
Twin who Laments the Past
Hiyok's friend and a resident of Taozhe. The younger twin to Zhia, who cares deeply about his sister. Compared to his sister's more outgoing personality, he's a bit more introverted.
From Voltage Inc.
"Hahaha, see? If ya don't come out, I'll end up killin' the both of ya! Hurry up and come out!"
Illogical Brute
The most powerful fighter of any mafia in the underworld.
He is a maverick, and his actions are guided purely by whatever he finds most enjoyable in the moment.
He feels no guilt, whether it comes to murder or betrayal.
From Voltage Inc.
"I made a bet. Against the heavens. And the result is Nine Gates. ...Looks like the heavens are on my side."
Unparalleled Fraudster
Boss of the Yuan family. He's aloof, doesn't play far, and loves to rile up whoever he's up against.
He favors gambling and cheating.
From Voltage Inc.
"Oh hush. Whoever will notice that it's not real? Kumyo is filled with only the blind!"
Adorned in Gilded Opulence

The boss of the Shao family, who presents himself more like an aristocrat than the boss of a mafia. He lacks the intimidation of a true mafioso boss, and neither his subordinates, nor Gonglu, have any respect for him. He's fond of luxury, and spends money like it's hot water.
From Voltage Inc.
"Now, this entire country is mine. I'm the one who makes all the rules."
Insatiable Tyrant
Boss of the biggest mafia in Kumyo, and political tycoon with power beyond the business world.
He controls both the public and underworld of Kumyo.
He's fond of beautiful women, valuables, and alcohol, his greed insatiable.
From Voltage Inc.
"Everyone's desperate to get close to Mr. Mun. Hah. Filthy hyenas."
Devotee of the Guiding Light
Mun's right-hand man. He supports Mun not only as a member of the mafia, but acts as an excellent secretary for Sodyk Real Estate.
He has the utmost respect for Mun, and works hard to realize his ideals.
From Voltage Inc.
"The boss is real smart. I'm an idiot, so I don't get what he's saying a lot of the time, but I know he's never wrong."
Enforcer through Innocence
A Sodyk family capo. While not all that intelligent, he's powerful on the battlefield, and will execute any task given by Mun without any hesitation.
From Voltage Inc.
"Isn't that the main reason people like us end up divin' into the underworld here in Kumyo?"
Fair-faced Strummer of Harmonies
Sun family capo and Maslo's closest friend. Determined to protect their home, they founded the Sun family together.
From Voltage Inc.
"...All I'm good at is following orders."
Sinking into Obscurity
A Zhuo family grunt. He's currently assigned to be the escort and caretaker of Biying's mistress.
From Voltage Inc.
"Haah, what a pain..."
Seeker of Shadows
Shao family capo. Hasn't an ounce of respect toward Feng, but plenty of complaints. He works as staff at Feng's store.
From Voltage Inc.
"I really like travel. That's why I like the freedom of being a courier, it means I can work wherever I want."
Easygoing Wanderer
One of the heroine's delivery buddies, who cares about her. He's friendly and approachable, and naturally tends to make others lower their guard.
From Voltage Inc.
"I believe you're aware, but I'm Biying's woman. One wrong move, and you won't live to see tomorrow."
Femme Fatal
A former announcer and reporter for a local station. Her good looks caught Biying's eye, and he made her his mistress.
From Voltage Inc.
"...Well, enough chit-chat. You came here for information, right?"
Steering the Way to Utopia
A former police officer turned informant. He helps Lowd get back on his feet after losing his family.
From Voltage Inc.
"But my ex was like, ugh, this coconut isn't authentic. Like any of us know what the real thing tastes like, right?"
Lovesick Darling
One of the heroine's few friends. She's bubbling, charming, and as sweet as sugar. Her major flaw is that he tends to get too attached to her boyfriends.
From Voltage Inc.
"I've been waiting for you."
Pursuer of Solutions
A genius scientist. Currently working on genetic research.
From Voltage Inc.
"If we let a traitor go, it sets a bad example. You'll make a great lesson, you two."
Obstructer of Freedom
Biying's subordinate who's assigned to supervise the Taozhe district. The residents of Taozhe view him as a tyrant.
From Voltage Inc.
"The boss wants to see you. Will you come with me?"
Money-Hungry Browbeater
Yuan Gonglu's capo. After losing a bet to Gonglu, he was forced to become his subordinate.
From Voltage Inc.
"Look at you, actin' all tough when you don't even have a frayglyph!"
Sly-Hearted Bully
A member of the Zhuo family who supervises Taozhe alongside Yuzak. Looks down on anyone weaker than him, and curries favor with the strong.
From Voltage Inc.
